events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body: The driver cancelled this RydeX trip and a $6.61 cancellation fee was charged, so the case enters through NS-0's driver-cancelled / rider-no-show branch: the driver's cancellation is assessed under NS-1 / NS-2 [F4][F7]. NS-1 (i) is met — the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 14:14:10 — and NS-1 (ii) is met, since the GPS placed him 41 m from the pickup at that moment, well inside the 200 m radius [F6][F1]. NS-1 (iii), however, fails: after the arrival confirmation the driver stayed within the radius for only 1 min 40 s and cancelled at 14:15:50, short of the required continuous wait of more than 3 minutes [F6][F5][F3]. The driver's message "3 min up, cancelling the trip" at 14:15 does not rescue the fee — the measured wait, not the driver's assertion, governs, and even his own tap-to-cancel interval is under 3 minutes [F10][F6][NS-1]. His post-trip statement that he pressed "I'm Here" and waited for the rider is likewise a claim that cannot override the GPS and timeline records [F12][F3][F4]. Because one of the NS-1 conditions is not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full, i.e. $6.61 [F7][NS-2]. The NS-2 flag_account limb is not triggered: the trace shows the arrival confirmation was genuine (driver genuinely within 200 m, 41 m at tap, closest approach 38 m), so no fake confirmation occurred [F6][F1][NS-2]. The driver's 90-day record shows one prior upheld no-show dispute, but RD-6 is about route disputes and this is a no-show case where the fee falls away entirely, so no account action is warranted here [F17][RD-6]. No route-deviation segments exist in this case, so segment_findings is empty [F4][RD-1].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: Good news — your $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded in full. We checked the driver's arrival and wait records: although he marked himself as arrived at your pickup point, his wait there lasted only about 1 minute 40 seconds before he cancelled, which is short of the minimum wait required. Because that condition wasn't met, the cancellation fee shouldn't have been charged, so we're returning it to you as a $6.61 Ryde voucher. There's nothing you need to do, and no action is being taken on your account.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation on this trip. You did mark yourself as arrived at the pickup point from within range, so we found no false arrival confirmation and no action is being taken on your account. However, the records show your time stopped at the pickup before cancelling was about 1 minute 40 seconds, which is under the minimum wait required before a cancellation fee applies. Because of that, the $6.61 cancellation fee is being refunded to the rider as a Ryde voucher. Keep in mind that in future trips a cancellation fee needs the full required wait after marking yourself as arrived.
